regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, non-cohesive rotation: Diversified Miners lead the raw momentum rank but are ineligible (subscription_gate false, durability_bar 0.27, breadth 0.0), while Banks (H+HK) sit just behind at rank 2 and are the only headline-eligible durable theme (eligibility true, durability_bar 0.68, breadth 0.769). Four of 17 themes are eligible, one_narrative is false, and the gate does help on this market's history (drawdown control validated), so trend discipline adds value even though cross-sectional rank is not alpha. Nearly all themes are unscorable, leaving very little that can be checked against a proxy.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Diversified Miners (current nominal rank-1 leader) gains eligibility — specifically durability_bar rising from 0.27 toward the 0.5+ zone combined with breadth moving above 0.3. theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the cleanest durable-leadership read: eligible for the trend gate, highest durability_bar among eligible themes at 0.68, strong breadth 0.769, and rank 2 close behind the ineligible miners leader. The rotation structure shows miners as nominal leader without eligibility or breadth, while banks are the challenger with actual staying-power texture. This is a focus lens plus the one validated edge (absolute-trend gate) saying banks are the trend-eligible place to be. Scored as a directional lean, not a prediction.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank-IC is weak, so the high score carries no edge; hurst_tag is 'mixed' not 'trend', and banks have no scorable proxy here, so the call cannot be independently graded against an ETF. Banks could simply be a slow-bleed laggard that looks durable by default.

theses.thesis: The only other eligible theme with a real durability bar (0.55) and a positive rank (4, score 0.823). In a narrow-rotation regime (eligible frac 0.24) with no clear one-narrative, dividend blue chips offer the trend-gate-approved defensive exposure that has historically reduced drawdown on this market. Hurst is 'trend', so it is genuinely trending rather than mixed.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: Rank 13 with a sharply negative score (-0.708), mean-reverting hurst tag, durability_bar 0.16, and ineligible for the trend gate. This is one of only two themes with a scorable proxy (3033.HK), so the avoid lean is checkable. The gate's drawdown-control edge argues against holding a mean-reverting, ineligible theme while trend discipline is the only validated tool.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting themes can bounce; a deeply negative momentum rank says nothing about forward return, and avoiding it just because it is rank-last would be treating the rank as alpha when the backtest says it is not.
